item.title: Vagus Nerve Stimulation May Strengthen New Skills
item.description: Stimulating the vagus nerve after practice helped mice develop stronger long-term motor learning, indicating a potentially important window.

item.title: Mysterious Moon hole may lead to giant cave
item.description: NASA selected the GIMLI project to investigate whether the Marius Hill Pit opens into a vast underground cave or lava tube using radar and seismic data.

item.title: Saturn and Halley's Comet debris visible in October skies
item.description: October skywatchers can observe Saturn at opposition, see Orionid meteors from Halley's Comet, and watch the Moon pass by a famous celestial object.

item.title: Human brain gene found to jump through DNA
item.description: Scientists have identified a human gene that serves a dual role: it contributes to brain cell function while retaining the ability to jump within DNA.
